events.title: Salesforce Force.com launched
events.summary: Marc Benioff unveiled Force.com on September 17, 2007 at Dreamforce — rebranding Salesforce's Apex development platform as a PaaS for custom business apps.
events.about: Force.com let developers write Apex code and Visualforce UIs that run on Salesforce's multi-tenant cloud — custom CRM extensions, industry apps, and ISV products on AppExchange. It turned Salesforce from a single CRM product into a programmable platform rivaling on-prem [middleware].

narrative.whyChosen: Force.com defined enterprise PaaS: build and host custom apps on someone else's CRM cloud.
narrative.whyImportant: Apex and Visualforce became the template for extensible SaaS platforms.
narrative.problemSolved: Enterprises needed custom business logic without buying servers or maintaining [middleware] stacks.

sources.title: ZDNet — Dreamforce 07: Salesforce rolls out Visualforce (September 17, 2007)
